response.sql: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT c.location AS city, COUNT(q.qualifyId) AS qualifying_count FROM circuits AS c LEFT JOIN races AS r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId LEFT JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY c.location), city_shares AS (SELECT city, qualifying_count, qualifying_count * 1.0 / SUM(qualifying_count) OVER () AS qualifying_share, 1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER () AS average_city_share FROM city_counts) SELECT city, qualifying_count, qualifying_share, qualifying_share - average_city_share AS share_above_average FROM city_shares WHERE qualifying_share > average_city_share ORDER BY share_above_average DESC, city;
